name: Love Thy Neighbor
summary: Cassandra Wheeler asks you to bring her farm's surplus produce to Halligan Turner at Turner's Logging Camp. She hopes the workers can enjoy some variety in their meals.

sections.title: A Neighbor's Gift
sections.body: Cassandra Wheeler farms north of Farholde and brings her harvest there to sell. She sets aside what remains for people who could use a lift. The logging camp lies north of her farm, beside the river, and she thinks its workers could use fruit and vegetables. You carry her surplus to Halligan Turner, the camp foreman.

sections.title: At the Camp
sections.body: Halligan Turner receives the goods with gratitude. The workers have little beyond meat and bread, so he plans to share the produce among them. He hopes to return Cassandra's kindness in time.

faq.q: Who is asking for the delivery?
faq.answer: Cassandra Wheeler asks you to carry her farm's surplus produce to Halligan Turner.
Halligan Turner is the foreman at Turner's Logging Camp.
Turner's Logging Camp is north of Cassandra's farm, beside the river.
She sends surplus fruit and vegetables from her farm.

faq.q: Why does Cassandra set aside farm goods?
faq.answer: After harvest, Cassandra saves what she does not sell to give to people who could use a lift.

faq.q: What do the logging camp workers usually eat?
faq.answer: Halligan says the workers eat little besides meat and bread.
